solver_initialization.actual_point: candidate convex combination; changes when inversion changes anchors

shadow_payment.positive_allocation: positive above threshold then normalize; no positive gives full reserve
shadow_payment.rounding: integer largest remainder, tie by str(agent_id)

statistics.cohorts: clean K3 and controlled_poison K5, each 10 teams, separately
statistics.inversion_axis: 30 within-team pairs: fixed solver coefficient index, vary r
statistics.solver_axis: 15 within-team pairs: fixed r, vary solver coefficient index
statistics.scope: descriptive intervals, team equal weight; no prespecified robustness pass threshold or multiple-testing superiority claim

matched_shapley.subsets: all 2^K subsets of fixed team; jointly remove anchors/models and renormalize alpha
matched_shapley.search: same full-team initial point for every subset, frozen custom30
matched_shapley.common_utility: vF(C)=F_N(start)-F_N(X_C), fixed full-model uniform panel for all C
matched_shapley.Fminus: not a common characteristic function; excluded from single-game Shapley comparison
matched_shapley.scope: fixed-full-team-conditioned game; initial point retains full-anchor information, full evaluator uses excluded models; no fairness or deployment claim

limits: Fixed historical models, no new independent model confirmation
Fixed membership with forced contamination, no new gate/retraining
Changing local inversion changes anchors and actual convex-combination warm start
Across solver starts anchors and model objective remain fixed
Full LOO uses same full-team start, not a complete recruitment/inversion rerun
Shared per-job cache reports total study cost, not independent method cost
High inverse residuals, reserve, failures, undefined ranks all retained
Historical 600 games are separate in SHAPLEY.md; cannot pair their scores to these role teams
